svg.text: People are found only by immutable platform ids, never by display names. Authority comes from the database, never from message text.
LINKING A NEW CHANNEL TO THE OWNER
relation: manager, colleague, external or contact. Set by the app or
operator, never by what a message says

Nothing is merged automatically (ADR 0008): one owner is one Person with up to three ChannelIdentity rows, each linked by an app-issued code. Roles (manager, colleague)
come from Person.relation. The web chat is trusted because it carries the session cookie; the pipeline builds its message with provider "web" and the person id.
A name or handle claim; never grants anything
Verified platform id but not linked: a stranger

If Dana exists, a code goes to her

Example: Meera writes to the owner's Telegram bot from an unknown account. She is a stranger (tier 1), whatever name she gives.
Dana, a colleague who is already linked on Slack, can add Telegram by redeeming a code the app sent her, never by typing her
